scripts.build: tsc -b packages/schema packages/core packages/node packages/next packages/store packages/insights packages/auth apps/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/schema packages/core packages/node packages/next packages/store packages/insights packages/auth apps/server && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/dashboard/tsconfig.json
scripts.dashboard: npm run build --silent && npm run build -w @abigaail/dashboard && NODE_ENV=production NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 node --env-file-if-exists=apps/dashboard/.env apps/dashboard/server.mjs
scripts.dashboard:dev: npm run build --silent && NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 node --env-file-if-exists=apps/dashboard/.env apps/dashboard/server.mjs --dev
scripts.app:create: npm run build --silent && node apps/server/dist/cli.js create
scripts.app:disable: npm run build --silent && node apps/server/dist/cli.js disable
scripts.app:list: npm run build --silent && node apps/server/dist/cli.js list
scripts.user:create: npm run build --silent && node apps/server/dist/user-cli.js create
scripts.user:disable: npm run build --silent && node apps/server/dist/user-cli.js disable
scripts.user:reset-mfa: npm run build --silent && node apps/server/dist/user-cli.js reset-mfa
scripts.user:unlock: npm run build --silent && node apps/server/dist/user-cli.js unlock
scripts.events:tail: npm run build --silent && node apps/server/dist/cli.js events
scripts.findings: npm run build --silent && node apps/server/dist/cli.js findings
scripts.agents:once: npm run build --silent && node apps/server/dist/cli.js agents-once
scripts.demo:next: npm run build --silent && npm run build -w @abigaail/demo-next && npm run start -w @abigaail/demo-next
